description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing and transforming database output data, including URL normalization, date parsing, challenge and survey data normalization, and profile UI settings validation.

methods.name: normalizeTwitter
methods.description: Converts a Twitter handle or URL to a URL.

methods.name: normalizeBluesky
methods.description: Converts a Bluesky handle or URL to a URL.

methods.name: normalizeDate
methods.description: Normalizes a date value to a timestamp number.

methods.name: normalizeChallengeType
methods.description: Normalizes a challenge type value to a number.

methods.name: normalizeProfileUI
methods.description: Ensures profile UI settings are valid, defaulting nulls to false or providing defaults.

methods.name: removeNulls
methods.description: Removes null properties from an object.

methods.name: normalizeChallenges
methods.description: Normalizes an array of CompletedChallenge objects, converting dates and challenge types, and removing nulls.

methods.name: normalizeSurveys
methods.description: Removes extra properties from Survey objects, returning only title and responses.

methods.name: normalizeFlags
methods.description: Replaces null boolean flags with false.
